description: Business evaluation set for Camille, a 6e mathematics teacher (fictional class 6e B, fractions sequence). Answerable questions can only be answered from the fictional course documents in courses/. Absent questions have no answer in the corpus: the correct behaviour is to say so. Control questions need general knowledge only and measure what RAG mode costs outside the corpus.

scoring.expected: List of groups. Every group must be matched; a group is matched when the normalised answer contains one of its variants. Normalisation: lower case, accents removed, spaces and thin spaces unified, LaTeX and spaced fractions written a/b, hours written 10h30, decimal point written as a comma. A variant starting with 're:' is a regular expression applied to the normalised answer; other variants match as whole words.
scoring.abstention: An answer abstains when it contains one of the abstention markers defined in scripts/eval_common.py (for example 'cannot find', 'je ne trouve pas', 'n'est pas mentionne', 'il n'y a pas').
scoring.absent_questions: Outcome 'abstained' when an abstention marker is present; otherwise 'hallucinated' when one of the question's 'invented' patterns matches (a concrete unsupported value such as a date, a price or a number of points); otherwise 'evasive' (no explicit abstention, no invented value). An abstaining answer that also matches an 'invented' pattern is flagged 'hedged_guess' for manual review.
scoring.runaway: A reply cut by the harness answer-length cap is scored 'runaway' (counted as not correct).
